hero.subtitle: I design. I build. I keep learning.
hero.description: I'm a fourth-year Software Engineering student who enjoys designing software architectures, implementing innovative solutions, and continuously learning throughout the process.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hey there! I'm a fourth-year Software Engineering student at UPC (Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas) with a strong interest in backend and full-stack development. I enjoy designing software architectures, building web and mobile applications with technologies like Spring Boot, Vue.js, and Flutter, and finding creative solutions to technical challenges.
about.p2: I'm always looking for opportunities to learn, experiment with new technologies, and improve the way I develop software. I'm particularly interested in software architecture, AI agent integration, and emerging technologies. I also enjoy working in teams, sharing ideas, and learning from others, as I believe collaboration plays an important role in building better solutions.
about.p3: I'm constantly working on improving my skills and turning ideas into functional applications. Feel free to explore my projects and see what I'm building!
